en-US.description: Upload one product image and generate the same product from a new camera angle while preserving its shape, material, color, and key details.
en-US.empty.viewMode: Select at least one target view
en-US.error.noSize: The current model has no available size configuration
en-US.error.referenceLimit: Reference image limit reached for the current model
en-US.error.references: The image is missing a usable resource identifier
en-US.label: Product Multi-view
en-US.placeholder.customView: Example: rotate the product slightly to the right and show the back label area
en-US.placeholder.extra: Example: keep the label position, do not invent readable text, emphasize the side thickness
en-US.placeholder.subjectDescription: Example: black ankle boots, perfume bottle, backpack, white appliance. Leave empty for AI auto-detection.
en-US.upload.productImage.help: Upload one product, apparel, footwear, bag, packaging, appliance, furniture, or accessory image. AI will auto-detect the subject unless you add a subject description.

zh-CN.description: 上传单张商品图，生成同一商品在新视角下的图片，并尽量保持形状、材质、颜色和关键细节一致。
zh-CN.empty.customView: 请输入自定义目标视角
zh-CN.empty.viewMode: 请至少选择 1 个目标视角
zh-CN.error.noModels: 暂无可用 AI 模型
zh-CN.error.noSize: 当前模型缺少可用尺寸配置
zh-CN.error.referenceLimit: 参考图数量已达当前模型上限
zh-CN.error.references: 图片缺少可用于生成的资源标识
zh-CN.label: 商品多视角
zh-CN.placeholder.customView: 如：商品向右旋转一点，展示背标区域
zh-CN.placeholder.extra: 如：保留标签位置，不要编造可读文字，突出侧面厚度
zh-CN.placeholder.subjectDescription: 如：黑色短靴、香水瓶、双肩包、白色小家电。不填则由 AI 自动识别。
zh-CN.toast.success: 商品多视角图生成成功！
zh-CN.upload.productImage.help: 支持上传商品、服饰、鞋靴、包袋、包装、小家电、家具或配饰图。不填写主体描述时，AI 会自动识别主体。
